about_bio: P S Kulkarni, also known as Darshan Kulkarni, is a practicing astrologer with more than 35 years of experience.

He received formal training in astrology from Jyotir Vidyalaya, Mumbai, along with guidance from various gurus. He formally graduated from Mumbai University and completed a postgraduate diploma in finance.

He comes from a very traditional, Karmath Brahmin family. Since childhood, his life was not about cartoons, but about mantras, the Gayatri Mantra, Sandhya, and many more practices. He did not understand their meaning back then.
As he grew up, a curiosity was born: Why do we do this? What is this knowledge? What is birth? What is death? What happens after that?
These questions led him to the Upanga of the Vedas, that is, astrology. He did not choose this path; this path chose him. The questions pulled him automatically toward this field.
approach_text: We follow a holistic approach to analyze your birth constitution. With the help of your detailed horoscope, KP System, and Gochar (transit), we deeply analyze your current situation and problems, frame a precise timeline of events, and guide you on when and how to overcome them through the power of chanting Shlokas, Mantras, and spiritual remedies.
credentials_list: 35+ years of experience in Vedic astrology consulting
